sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: Intelligent Transcription with a Speech ...
sources.snippet: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech LLM for intelligent transcription: a single model that transcribes 40 languages verbatim or in written form, with context, speaker attribution, and word timestamps, selected with a natural language instruction. It is the best open-weights model on the English and multilingual Open ASR Leaderboards.

sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-FP8 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open-weight, offline speech and audio model for transcription in 40 languages, with support for recordings up to one hour and a 65,536-token context. Its hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture activates approximately 4.3B parameters, including the audio encoder, and it is released in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 precision.
